## What's new

- Choose one of eight selector colors in **Settings → Ambience**. Cards, focus rings, switches and sliders use the saved accent throughout the app.
- Browse eleven settings pages in a dark, searchable sidebar. Use the arrows to navigate, OK to open a page and Back to return. Slim graphite scrollbars blend into the dark interface.
- Select multiple installed apps and portable shortcuts in one picker. Selections survive searches and refreshes. On a remote, press Right from a selected app to reach the Add button.
- Repair a moved executable or shortcut with **Locate application**. Confirm the new location to keep the card's artwork, favorites, category and position. You can also open an application directly from its card menu.
- See the steps of the most recent TV wake attempt. When power is confirmed and HDMI selection fails, retry just the input command.

## Windows 11 x64

Download **Canapey.Launcher_0.10.0_x64-setup.exe** to install. Existing installations on the experimental 0.x update channel can check for updates from **Settings → Updates**. The updater verifies the Tauri signature. The installer SHA-256 is in **SHA256SUMS.txt**.

TV and iPhone compatibility still require confirmation on physical hardware.
